extraction.notes: Three months ended 6/30/2024 column of S-8 (seq 13). Reconciliation starts from net loss available to common shareholders and ends at Core FFO applicable to common shares and Units (not diluted). The FFO and Core FFO subtotals before the Series D preferred dividend add-back are used as ffo_total and core_total; the diluted figures ($22,303 FFO, $22,961 Core FFO) add back $160 Series D dividends and are not used as totals. Diluted share count 18,129 reproduces reported per-share values: 22,303/18,129 = $1.23 and 22,961/18,129 = $1.27. Company reports no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Interest rate swap amortization was classified as debt_cost_amortization (judgment call). Other miscellaneous items (3) are described in the filing as (gain) loss on investments and pursuit costs; classified as other. Recurring capex: the portfolio summary (seq 20, S-15) shows Total Recurring Capital Expenditures per apartment home, Same-Store, $264 for 6/30/2024 (per home, not a total dollar amount), so it was not recorded as an amount; null used. Impairment and gain/loss on sale lines are zero in the current quarter.
